subject.title: feat(ios): unify chat and voice experience

question: Should iOS permanently remove the standalone Talk destination and route the existing `talk` and `voice` launch aliases to the unified Chat surface?
rationale: The linked issue asks for this direction, and the branch implements it with strong evidence, but this remains a user-visible navigation and upgrade-policy decision that cannot be resolved mechanically by review.

options.title: Adopt unified Chat
options.body: Accept Chat as the permanent conversational destination and merge after final required checks confirm the reviewed head.

options.title: Retain standalone Talk
options.body: Keep Talk as a root destination and request a narrower follow-up that preserves current navigation while sharing only safe ownership infrastructure.

recommendation.title: Adopt unified Chat
recommendation.body: Accept Chat as the permanent conversational destination and merge after final required checks confirm the reviewed head.

likelyOwner.reason: The previous completed review explicitly routed the product-direction decision here, though repository-history ownership could not be established from the supplied review context alone.
